name: Train Booking Confirmation
description: Confirmation email sent when a train ticket is booked
subject: Train Booking Confirmation - Booking #{booking_id}
body_html:
Train Booking Confirmation

Dear {customer_name},

Your train ticket has been booked successfully!

Booking Details

Booking ID:#{booking_id}
Departure Station:{departure_station}
Arrival Station:{arrival_station}
Departure Date:{departure_date}
Departure Time:{departure_time}
Ticket Type:{ticket_type}
Price:£{price}
Payment Method:{payment_method}

Important: Please arrive at the station at least 15 minutes before departure.

Your ticket can be collected at the station ticket machine using your booking reference.

Best regards,
Train Service

customer_name.description: Name of the customer who booked the ticket

ticket_type.description: Type of ticket (e.g., Single, Return, Student)
